### 1. Architecture Overview
- The change adds `WaitForCacheSync(ctx context.Context) bool` to `cache.SharedInformer`. Any custom SharedInformer or informer-factory wrappers must expose/forward the new context-based wait, otherwise they will stop compiling when the upstream interface expands.
- Across the four projects, only the informer factory / informer wrapper implementations need code changes; pure consumers that just call `cache.WaitForCacheSync` or run stock client-go informers will continue to work once client-go is updated.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- **Argo CD**
  - `pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go`: The custom `sharedInformerFactory` implements `WaitForCacheSync(stopCh <-chan struct{}) map[reflect.Type]bool` (L141–159) and the `SharedInformerFactory` interface exposes the same signature (L230–233) using a stop channel. Both the method and interface must be updated to accept `context.Context` to satisfy the new `SharedInformer` contract and to propagate context cancellation (evidence: file content lines 141–159 and 230–233).
- **cert-manager**
  - `internal/informers/core_basic.go`: `baseFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh <-chan struct{}) map[string]bool` forwards to the upstream factory (L58–64). Needs the new `context.Context` signature.
  - `internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go`: 
    - `filteredSecretsFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh <-chan struct{})` fans out to typed and metadata factories (L101–115) — must take `context.Context`.
    - The custom `informer` struct (the combined typed/metadata informer) implements `HasSynced` and `AddEventHandler` (L193–204). If it is treated as a `cache.SharedInformer`, it must add `WaitForCacheSync(ctx)` as well.
  - `pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go`: The generated `sharedInformerFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh <-chan struct{})` (L159–177) and `SharedInformerFactory` interface (L248–250) use the stop-channel signature; both must be updated to context.
- **Prometheus**
  - `discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go`: The discoverer constructs and runs many `cache.SharedInformer` instances (e.g., endpoint slices, pods, services). These are started with `Run(ctx.Done())` (L431–452, L606–614). To align with the new method, any sync waiting logic should be switched to call `informer.WaitForCacheSync(ctx)` (or to propagate context when using the new method) instead of the stop-channel form.
- **OpenTelemetry Operator**
  - `cmd/otel-allocator/internal/collector/collector.go`: Uses a shared informer factory and runs `informer.Run(k.close)` (L67–98). Any cache sync waits (if added) must use the new `WaitForCacheSync(ctx)` signature.
  - `cmd/otel-allocator/internal/watcher/promOperator.go`: Provides `WaitForNamedCacheSync` using `cache.WaitForNamedCacheSync(controllerName, ctx.Done(), inf)` (L541–568). When `SharedInformer` gains `WaitForCacheSync(ctx)`, this watcher should call the new method (or adapt its timeout wrapper) to stay consistent with the updated interface.

### 3. Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| argo-cd | pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go | Implements `sharedInformerFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh <-chan struct{})` and exposes the same in `SharedInformerFactory` interface; must add context-based method to match new `SharedInformer` contract (L141–159, L230–233). |
| cert-manager | internal/informers/core_basic.go | `baseFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh)` delegates to upstream factory; must accept `context.Context` (L58–64). |
| cert-manager | internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go | `filteredSecretsFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh)` (L101–115) and the custom `informer` wrapper (HasSynced/AddEventHandler, L193–204) need to implement/forward the new `WaitForCacheSync(ctx)`. |
| cert-manager | pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go | Generated `sharedInformerFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh)` and interface declaration use stop channels (L159–177, L248–250); must be updated to context. |
| prometheus | discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go | Runs multiple `cache.SharedInformer` instances with `Run(ctx.Done())` (e.g., L431–452, L606–614); cache sync waiting should switch to the new `WaitForCacheSync(ctx)` signature when available. |
| opentelemetry-operator | cmd/otel-allocator/internal/collector/collector.go | Uses informer factory and runs informers (L67–98); any cache sync wait logic must be updated to call `WaitForCacheSync(ctx)`. |
| opentelemetry-operator | cmd/otel-allocator/internal/watcher/promOperator.go | Wraps cache sync in `WaitForNamedCacheSync` (L541–568); should adapt to call the new context-based `SharedInformer.WaitForCacheSync(ctx)`/timeout wrapper to remain compatible. |

These are the informer implementations/wrappers in ArgoCD, cert-manager, Prometheus, and the OpenTelemetry Operator that must be updated to implement or use the new `WaitForCacheSync(ctx context.Context)` method on `cache.SharedInformer`.

SUMMARY: Adding WaitForCacheSync(ctx context.Context) to the SharedInformer interface requires updating informer factory and wrapper implementations in ArgoCD, cert-manager, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry Operator to accept context instead of stop channels. Only these specific informer implementations need code changes; consumers using stock client-go informers will work once client-go is updated.

FILES:
- argo-cd/pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go — Implements sharedInformerFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh) and SharedInformerFactory interface; must update to context-based method
- cert-manager/internal/informers/core_basic.go — baseFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh) forwards to upstream factory; needs context signature
- cert-manager/internal/informers/core_filteredsecrets.go — filteredSecretsFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh) and custom informer wrapper need WaitForCacheSync(ctx)
- cert-manager/pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go — Generated sharedInformerFactory.WaitForCacheSync(stopCh) and interface use stop channels; must update to context
- prometheus/discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go — Runs cache.SharedInformer instances; cache sync waiting should switch to WaitForCacheSync(ctx)
- opentelemetry-operator/cmd/otel-allocator/internal/collector/collector.go — Uses informer factory; any cache sync wait logic must call WaitForCacheSync(ctx)
- opentelemetry-operator/cmd/otel-allocator/internal/watcher/promOperator.go — WaitForNamedCacheSync wraps cache sync; should adapt to call new WaitForCacheSync(ctx)
